description: This Java source file defines the JobWorkServiceActivity class, an Android activity that interacts with a JobScheduler to enqueue work items into a JobWorkService. It includes UI button handlers to enqueue jobs with different intents and to simulate killing the process.

classes.name: JobWorkServiceActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that manages job scheduling and enqueuing work items into JobWorkService using buttons.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the JobScheduler, configures buttons with onClick listeners.

methods.name: mEnqueue1Listener
methods.description: Enqueues a job with intent action 'com.example.android.apis.ONE' into the JobScheduler.

methods.name: mEnqueue2Listener
methods.description: Enqueues a job with intent action 'com.example.android.apis.TWO' into the JobScheduler.

methods.name: mEnqueue3Listener
methods.description: Enqueues a job with intent action 'com.example.android.apis.THREE' into the JobScheduler.

methods.name: mKillListener
methods.description: Kills the current process to simulate service being killed while running in background.
